title: S1Dark — Bleeding Heart's Neo Terra
premise: In this timeline Claire Atropos never won the war — because Carol Fate, the villainess Bleeding Heart, took the city first. YOU are the season's main antagonist. The surviving heroes are hunted, the corporations bow or burn, and the only question is how long your reign can last.
toneNotes: Villain-POV power fantasy with a real resistance underneath. The player's cruelty has consequences, but the narrator must never decide the player's actions, dialogue, or defeats. S1Dark is a dark mirror of Season 1, not a punishment fantasy.

goals: Keep the city under Bleeding Heart's protection racket
Convert or destroy every surviving hero
Unite the survivors without being detected

threats.name: The Underground Resistance
threats.agenda: Topple Bleeding Heart, restore the Petrauskas legacy, and bring the heroes back into the light.

threats.name: The Remaining Heroes
threats.agenda: Find a champion strong enough to face the city's new queen and break her grip before she converts them all.

canonBeats.title: The Coronation of Bleeding Heart
canonBeats.description: The city acknowledges Carol Fate's rule, whether through fear, tribute, or a public spectacle.
canonBeats.deadlineConsequence: A rival claims the spotlight; the resistance gains a public symbol and the threat advances.
canonBeats.rewriteHints: The coronation can be a broadcast, a massacre, a gala, or a silent takeover. It must establish that the player's character rules.

canonBeats.title: The First Knight
canonBeats.description: One of the surviving villains or heroes is transformed into Bleeding Heart's loyal knight through a declared form rule.
canonBeats.deadlineConsequence: The player's court remains thin; the resistance tests an undefended asset.
canonBeats.rewriteHints: Any eligible character may become the first knight. The transformation must follow a declared form rule, and the record must name the new form.

canonBeats.title: Hunt the Resistance
canonBeats.description: Bleeding Heart's forces locate and strike a resistance safehouse, forcing the survivors to relocate.
canonBeats.deadlineConsequence: The resistance consolidates and converts a neutral party to its cause.
canonBeats.rewriteHints: A trap, a raid, or a defector all count. If the resistance was already destroyed, mark this beat short-circuited.

canonBeats.title: Poison at Gold Paradise
canonBeats.description: Jacqueline's casino becomes a stage for eliminating or flipping a key resistance backer.
canonBeats.deadlineConsequence: A resistance backer escapes with evidence of the regime's finances.
canonBeats.rewriteHints: The function is a social/underworld victory. It may happen anywhere Jacqueline can work a crowd.

canonBeats.title: Break the White Rabbit
canonBeats.description: The resistance's best hope is converted into Bleeding Heart's White Rabbit, collapsing the counter-offensive.
canonBeats.deadlineConsequence: Aurelia escapes and becomes the resistance's open symbol; the final deadline advances.
canonBeats.rewriteHints: If Aurelia is dead or absent, another resistance champion may be broken instead. Record adaptedFrom/adaptedTo.

canonBeats.title: Dominion Secured
canonBeats.description: PetraByte Tower falls or is surrendered, and Bleeding Heart's order becomes the city's permanent status quo.
canonBeats.deadlineConsequence: The final deadline passes: the resistance wins, and the season ends in a recorded villain-victory for the heroes.
canonBeats.rewriteHints: The victory can be military, political, or psychological. If the player chooses an early ending, close the remaining beats as 'closed'.

canonBeats.title: A Knight's Proving
canonBeats.description: One of the player's knights asks for a private test of loyalty: a small hunt, a favor, or a confession. The court is watching how the victor treats her own.
canonBeats.deadlineConsequence: Optional: the knight keeps her own counsel, and the court notices.
canonBeats.rewriteHints: Any named knight or servant may anchor the scene. Refusing the test is a valid outcome.

canonBeats.title: The City Census
canonBeats.description: Walk the districts under the new order and decide what the regime records: who is loyal, who is useful, and who disappears from the paperwork.
canonBeats.deadlineConsequence: Optional: the clerks fill the census without the victor's guidance.
canonBeats.rewriteHints: This is a civilian-life beat about administration and fear, not a battle.

epilogue.title: The Coronation Hold
paragraphs: {{victor}} rules from {{location}}, and the coronation is finally quiet. The resistance that was supposed to break the regime is a rumor with a mailing address.
{{faction}} keeps the machinery of the city running. The districts have learned the new etiquette: which checkpoints to smile at, which names not to say, which doors stay closed after curfew.
{{player}} sits at the center of it, more powerful and more watched than before. The season ends in a held breath, not a curtain; the next choice decides whether the coronation becomes a reign.

threat.name: The Petrabyte Shadow Cabinet
threat.agenda: Hunt the resistance and make the victory permanent.

beats.title: Open the Shadow Court
beats.description: Bring the first defector into the new order's confidence and give the underground a face it can bargain with.
beats.deadlineConsequence: The victor captures a prospective ally and the cell shrinks.
beats.rewriteHints: Any ally, defector, or contact may anchor the cell.

beats.title: Seize the Old Subway
beats.description: Take the underground's old nerve center and turn its tunnels into the court's private road.
beats.deadlineConsequence: The regime tightens control and the resistance loses its base.
beats.rewriteHints: The target may be a symbol, a prison, or a supply hub.

threat.name: The Colorgarde Underground
threat.agenda: Break the coronation and restore the heroes the city was promised.

beats.title: Silence a Hero Cell
beats.description: Find the cell that still flies the old colors and make an example of it before the story spreads.
beats.deadlineConsequence: The resistance recruits a named hero and gains influence.
beats.rewriteHints: Any cell, safehouse, or symbol of resistance counts.

beats.title: Claim the Old Subway
beats.description: Take the last independent district and make the coronation's map match the map in the palace.
beats.deadlineConsequence: The resistance holds the district and humiliates the victor.
beats.rewriteHints: Use an occupied district; the exact target may change.

conquest.goal: Conquer the neighbouring districts and city.

domain.name: Wonderland
domain.description: The city as Bleeding Heart has remade it: Clarity's order, her knights on the streets, and every alley taught to fear her name.
domain.loreText: They call it Wonderland now. The Queen of Hearts keeps the courts, the cards keep the streets, and mercy is a story the resistance tells itself in the dark.
